title: Local Marketing: A Complete Guide | Salesforce UK

facts.fact: Salesforce's own research states that 80% of shoppers say the experience a company provides is just as important as its products or service.
facts.quote: 80% of shoppers say that the experience a company provides is just as important as its products or service.

facts.fact: In the page's illustrative bakery example, a $1,000 broad online advertising campaign across the entire city reached 10,000 people, with 100 converting into customers, a 1% conversion rate.
facts.quote: This campaign reaches 10,000 people, but only 100 of them convert into customers, resulting in a conversion rate of 1%.

facts.fact: In the page's illustrative bakery example, a $1,000 localized Facebook ad campaign aimed at residents within a 5-mile radius of the storefront reached 2,500 people, with 200 converting, an 8% conversion rate.
facts.quote: 200 people convert into customers, doubling the conversion rate to 8%.

facts.fact: The illustrative localized campaign used $1,000 in targeted Facebook ads aimed at residents within a 5-mile radius of the bakery's storefront.
facts.quote: targeted Facebook ads specifically aimed at residents within a 5-mile radius of their storefront.

facts.fact: Salesforce's State of Marketing report draws on nearly 5,000 marketers worldwide.
facts.quote: See the top trends in data, AI, and more — from nearly 5,000 marketers worldwide.

facts.fact: Demographic segmentation categorizes potential customers by age, gender, income level, education, occupation, and marital status.
facts.quote: This involves categorizing your potential customers based on factors such as their age, gender, income level, education, occupation, and marital status.

facts.fact: Instagram and Snapchat offer geotagging features that let users tag their location when posting content.
facts.quote: Platforms like Instagram and Snapchat offer geotagging features that allow users to tag their location when posting content.

facts.fact: Facebook lets businesses create and promote local events and join community pages relevant to their area.
facts.quote: Facebook provides opportunities for businesses to create and promote local events, as well as join community pages relevant to their area.

facts.fact: Many social media platforms offer advertising targeting options that include targeting users based on their location.
facts.quote: Many social media platforms offer sophisticated advertising targeting options, including the ability to target users based on their location.

facts.fact: The page recommends claiming business listings on Google My Business, Yelp, and Facebook to appear in local searches.
facts.quote: Claim your turf on popular platforms like Google My Business, Yelp, and Facebook to make sure you're front and center when local customers come calling.

facts.fact: The page states that Instagram tends to skew slightly older than TikTok, with a growing base of millennials and Gen Xers.
facts.quote: Instagram, for example, tends to skew slightly older than TikTok, with a growing user base of millennials and Gen Xers.

facts.fact: The page states that TikTok has gained immense popularity among Gen Z users, particularly for short-form video content.
facts.quote: TikTok, on the other hand, has gained immense popularity among Gen Z users, particularly for its short-form video content.

facts.fact: The page says Facebook may generally cater to an older demographic, though local communities or niche groups may still be highly active on it.
facts.quote: While Facebook may generally cater to an older demographic, certain local communities or niche interest groups within your area may still be highly active on the platform.

facts.fact: The page gives example local search phrases such as "best coffee shop in [city]" and "plumber near me" as long-tail keywords.
facts.quote: Think long-tail keywords packed with location-specific phrases like "best coffee shop in [city]" or "plumber near me."
